title: Products | Alai Labs
description: Alai Labs products: the Janitor Robot, the SensZ.AI edge AI sensor module and the Outdoor Cleaning Arm.

head.p_1: Three products built from the same robotics, edge AI and sensor work, each with a spec sheet and the places it is deployed.

all_products.p_1: A cleaning robot that maps restrooms with LIDAR and cleans them, while your team watches and controls it in a 3D view.
all_products.p_2: An edge AI module with an IP67 outdoor sensor, for object detection and live volume and weight measurement.
all_products.p_3: A robotic arm fitted to trucks, with LIDAR and AI cameras, for public cleaning and structural maintenance.
